answer_1.quote: Neural machine translation (NMT) ) models relying on text data have achieved state-of-the-art performance.

answer_2.quote: We adopted BLEU  and METEOR  as the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We did crowdsourcing on Amazon Mechanical Turk. We distribute each task to three workers.
answer_4.guideline: We ask workers if there is any subtitle strongly related to the video content. And we give workers four choices: (1) none of them; (2) only the first subtitle; (3) only the second subtitle; (4) both of them.
